seed_policy.stream_rule: stream_counter(batch, step) = ((batch << 32) | step) * 2**64, inherited verbatim from p4_theory_generalization/src/rebaseguard_p4_general/simulate.py

budget.note: path counts are variance derived and timing independent; the CPU projection is a measured rate on the pilot host and carries a x3 safety factor

stopping_rule.description: every configuration runs its frozen 200 blocks and stops

uncertainty_rule.se_a: batch standard error over 200 RB-SCORE block means
uncertainty_rule.se_b: hypot(batch standard error over 200 RB-MAP block means, T_B)
uncertainty_rule.T_B: |Richardson(0.2,0.1) - Richardson(0.05,0.025)| from the frozen FD ladder, rounded outward
uncertainty_rule.rationale: the historical |z| gate divided by Monte Carlo error alone; at P4Z precision the deterministic truncation residual is no longer negligible beneath it. Including a known error term widens the uncertainty honestly and does not move the threshold.
uncertainty_rule.pass: rel <= 0.03 AND z <= 4.0 AND both routes met r* AND both routes passed scale stability
uncertainty_rule.fail: rel > 0.03 OR z > 4.0, with both preconditions met
uncertainty_rule.inconclusive: any precondition unmet, any kill gate fired, or BUDGET_EXCLUDED
uncertainty_rule.multiple_comparison_correction: none applied and none removed; the frozen gate is a per-cell conjunction over 96 cells and is inherited as it stands

kill_gates.condition: any of the four alarm-set integrals differs from adaptive quadrature by more than 1e-7
alarm_bounds disagrees with the frozen Detector.step on any of 1e5 probe residuals
measured per-path relative sd exceeds the model by more than the x4 safety factor
projected CPU to complete exceeds the 2.0 CPU-h per-configuration cap
kill_gates.action: BUDGET_EXCLUDED; cells INCONCLUSIVE; no blocks bought

kill_gates.condition: top-1 share > 0.10 or top-5 share > 0.30 over the 200 block values
achieved Monte Carlo relative SE > r*

kill_gates.when: per configuration, on the FD ladder
kill_gates.condition: Richardson(0.2,0.1) and Richardson(0.05,0.025) differ by more than 0.02 relative
kill_gates.action: RB-MAP unusable on that configuration; cells INCONCLUSIVE

kill_gates.condition: any producer-gate failure: manifest mismatch, import outside the TCB, thread count != 1, stale producer hash, resume-key mismatch

kill_gate_trigger_discipline: K3, K5, K6 and K7 read precision and stability statistics only. None reads a discrepancy, a z, the sign of a disagreement, whether a cell is close to passing, or whether the campaign would close.

pilot_plan.stage_0: 20 blocks per configuration, all 24 configurations, to check the variance model and fire K3/K4 before the budget is committed; reads variance and cost only

full_run_command.command_when_authorised: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python production/run_p4z.py --checkpoint configs/checkpoint_p4z.json --stage 0
full_run_command.note: production/ does not exist in this commit, by design
full_run_command.host_constraint: must not be scheduled on a host whose cores are held by the CUSUM Aux4 campaign

residual_risks: 19 of 24 configurations were never piloted; laplace, logistic and skewnormal4 sit on the gaussian regime envelope (handled by Stage 0 and K3)
skewnormal4 is the least-exercised analytic branch, the only asymmetric family and the only non-elementary Mlow (handled by K1 at run time)
at P4Z precision |z| <= 4 becomes the binding gate rather than the 3 % relative gate; this is a property of the frozen gate, not of any estimator, and the threshold is not touched
RB-MAP is less independent than the historical Route B because it uses f and F analytically; disclosed, partly offset by the Route-Q and Corollary-G2 controls
both routes share the analytic TCB (handled by K1 and the fail-closed producer gate)
no_result_change_governance_statement: P4Z produces no scientific result artifact and changes no historical verdict. P4 remains PARTIAL. P4X and the four P4Y pilots remain exactly as their own branches record them. No PARTIAL, FAIL or INCOMPLETE is converted to PASS. No frozen numerical gate is relaxed. The only precision number P4Z chooses, 0.0025, is tighter than the frozen r*, which is not a threshold change.
